then.text: You found it, then. The vein. Half the visitors turn back at the water and buy a fudge instead. Respect.
Mind the steps on the way out. Dozens of people have said they will. I've watched all of them not.
Gate's open. Down the steps at the far end, then follow the stream. There are three levels, and each wants something different from you.
The stream passage floods. There's an old sluice valve on the near bank. Or you could wade it, if you've been taught how. And bring a lantern: some things only show in proper light.
At the bottom there's a slab you'll need to roll onto a plate. Straight lines, mostly. If you jam it in a corner, step out and come back in: the cave tidies itself.

else.text: Welcome to Blue John Cavern. I'd say mind your head, but the cave doesn't care what I say.
The gate to the steps is locked from my side. The lever by the desk works it. Give it a good pull; it's been pulled by worse.
